ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2.5:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones across both lateral lobes; central low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated around the median notch and extending horizontally into the mid-lobes; dark pixel clusters (mottling) scattered on the distal portion of the right lobe; black pigmentation present at both lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped depression at the center; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with multiple high-amplitude peaks and valleys; significant macro-indentation (semi-circular notch) on the right lobe inner trailing edge; fine-grain serrations visible along the entirety of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized low-intensity punctate clusters (dark spots) on the white background of the distal right lobe; sparse dark spotting near the left lobe trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel high-intensity (white) linear disruptions oriented vertically and diagonally within the central black pigmentation region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe indicating tissue loss; prominent rake marks visible in the central pigmented area.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate filigree-like white striations within the central black pigmentation zone.
